h: FG lists four steps to qualify for the ₦100,000 weekly Ebola payment
p: The Federal Government has reportedly set out four steps for people who want to qualify for the ₦100,000 weekly payment linked to the Ebola response. Details of eligibility were shared as the country remains on alert over the disease.
more: The WHO says Nigeria has no active Ebola case but is not yet declared Ebola-free.
Officials have urged Nigerians to rely on official channels for information.
